map.输入成本与售价，计算加价率（Markup）与销售利润率（Margin）并相互转换: Enter cost and selling price to compute markup and sales margin and convert between them, supporting product pricing and profit accounting.
map.知道成本想加价多少定售价。: Set the selling price when you know the cost and the markup you want.
map.知道目标利润率反推售价。: Back-derive the selling price from a target margin.
map.：成本 100、加价率 50% → 售价=100×(1+50%)=150，利润: : cost 100, markup 50% -> selling price = 100 x (1 + 50%) = 150, profit 50, margin = 50/150, about 33.33%.
map.：成本 100、目标利润率 33.33% → 售价=100/(1−33.33%): : cost 100, target margin 33.33% -> selling price = 100/(1 - 33.33%) = 150, markup = (150 - 100)/100 = 50%. The two are inverse calculations of each other.
map.加价率和利润率一样吗？: Are markup and margin the same?
map.不一样且易混。加价率以成本为基础，利润率以售价为基；同样 50% 加价只对应 3: They differ and are easily confused. Markup is based on cost, margin on selling price; the same 50% markup corresponds to only 33.33% margin.
map.怎么互转？: How do they convert into each other?
map.利润率=加价率/(1+加价率)，加价率=利润率/(1−利润率)，记住分母不同即可: Margin = markup / (1 + markup), and markup = margin / (1 - margin); just remember the denominators differ.
